content: Agudide Zonai nerut gaber ga detagri,
“Bakiamu Ninebeem able au utebem a leem etomeret able mir geka mari nakwari.”
Zonade Oplera mir dirmiri a bakiamuda Ninebeem able auka uteb irdiredi, lelut wais 3 gerger ko abi wadatupir.
Zona eudi digmi Ninebeige kemerkemer gerger keubu e able mir etomerti, “40 gergerge Ninebe ia obatkoare.”
Ninebei legize eudi tabara oka emarda Agudi mirge. Wi tabara batagerda ko gair le lewer obazigwarare a gair le aule kebilekem adud wali waitkirare a tababu obakekrare.
Nade Ninebera ople able miride erpeilu e ekweilu adem digem taba baolam, wali tabara adem igi, adud wali ami a tibige emrilu.
E able mir Ninebe leem emariklu: “Able ople a kerimle pa uridli iaba mir wabim pedike: nole lelut netat lewer wairuser; gair le a ebur peki sab daragrida arolam a arilam.”
Gair legize a eburgize ko adud wali obatkir. Gair le ko alel erkep obasamwa a tabara adud tonar lu aker wadikairtare.
Karim Agudide tabara akepwar urkerlam wadimipigemer ko omarem a mi nole nabaume.
Nade Agudide tadasmeri nalu wi ikerda a nako wi taba barbar tonarlam adem batarda Ege iabi omarge tarakerda a nole iabi daratkoda ge E detauti E ia waikaida.
